etc.example_en: He told his best friends Tom, Mary, etc. that he has cancer.

eternal.meaning: a. 永恒的, 永远的, 不灭的
eternal.example_en: The eternal silence of these infinite spaces terrifies me.

ethical.meaning: a. 伦理的, 民族的, 民族特有的
ethical.example_en: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
ethical.example_cn: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？

ethics.example_en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.

ethnic.meaning: a. 人种的, 种族的
ethnic.example_en: Hanfu is the traditional clothing used by the ethnic Han of China, before the Qing dynasty.
